Streamline FTIR for liquid samples on the Lyza 7000 spectrometer with Flow Cell Modules. Ready to start filling right away, they reduce the manual handling required with conventional liquid cells and ensure a fast, reproducible workflow across routine applications including diesel, base oil, and beverage analysis.
Develop methods directly on the instrument or start with application-specific presets for diesel, base oil, energy drinks, and more. A range of automation options lets you scale your setup according to throughput and workflow requirements, from push-button cleaning to fully automated sample sequences.
Key features
Application-specific presets for streamlined analysis
Create your own methods, including guided quantification or get started immediately with ready-to-use application presets. Presets for analysis such as taurine in energy drinks or betaine in molasses enable quick, seamless analysis without complex method development. 
Precise temperature control
High-precision temperature control minimizes temperature-induced measurement variability. The flow cells maintain temperatures with a stability of ±0.01 °C across a freely selectable range from 15 °C to 40 °C. This ensures consistent measurement conditions for repeatable and comparable results.
Flow-through design, ready for automation
Flow Cell Modules for Lyza 7000 can be combined with a range of automation options to suit your throughput needs, including the Xsample 3200 single-position sample changer with push-button cleaning and the Xsample 5200 multi-sample changer for fully automated sequences. 
Lyza 7000: Powerful FTIR for liquid samples
For liquid samples, Flow Cell Modules fit seamlessly into the modular cell concept of the Lyza 7000 spectrometer. Toolmaster automatically recognizes each module, making workflows faster and easier to run. With a best-in-class 15-year warranty on the instrument’s IR source, laser, and interferometer, you can count on consistent performance for years to come.
